title: [review] project-LICHEN-worker6-jjhj: schc/headers.rs write_ipv6_header takes (u8,u32) tuple for flow but callers pass 2 separate args
description: headers.rs line 268 defines `write_ipv6_header(..., flow: (u8, u32), ...)` accepting flow as a tuple. But 4 call sites (lines 465, 666, 840, 992) pass `(traffic_class, flow_label)` as separate positional args, giving "function takes 7 arguments but 8 were supplied". This is in the same crate, caught during cargo check. Fix: wrap traffic_class and flow_label in tuple at call sites, or change signature to take two separate params.
